slides.title:
Less than
*8 months* later,
she's moved off
the evening news.
slides.sub:
Sent to morning cut-ins.

“I knew it was a horrible
demotion,” she said.
“I was devastated.”

slides.title:
The station gives her
a local *talk show*:
“People Are Talking.” 🎙️
slides.sub:
Less reading the news.
More talking with real people.

That's where she shines.
